environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; iridescent metallic-green elytra (wing cases); heavy mandibles; tactile, segmented legs.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle shot of a beetle climbing over a ridge of bark. The beetle's shell reflects the green of the moss and the purple of the Anacleto clay. In the background, a dinosaur's footprint has collected a small pool of water.
visual_logic.ground: Rich, dark organic soil mixed with flaking bark and orange-colored fungi.
visual_logic.lighting: Sharp rays of light hitting the beetle's metallic back, creating bright specular highlights.
